articles.headline: Bournemouth rally to beat Sparta Prague, remain perfect in Europa League
articles.description: United States captain Tyler Adams scored his first goal since last November to help Bournemouth rally to a 3-1 win at Sparta Prague on Thursday and maintain their perfect record in this season's Europa League.
